summary: Fixed the one defect the validation found: the scratch finish runner fell back to Chrome paths written in its own code when CHROME_BIN was unset. I deleted CHROME_PATHS, and chrome() now reads only CHROME_BIN. It exits 3 with a stderr message when CHROME_BIN is unset, empty, not a file, or names an msedge* file. The docstrings and messages now describe CHROME_BIN-only behaviour. Everything else in the runner (read-only ledger SELECT, the ROOT and browser-list patches that must each match once, the no-Edge-text assertion, and the finish, look and serve modes) is unchanged. No Go, template, CSS or JS file changed.

files.why: Delete CHROME_PATHS. chrome() reads only CHROME_BIN, refuses any msedge* basename, and exits 3 (never 0 or 1) with a stderr message when it is unset, empty, not a file or Edge. Docstrings and messages rewritten with no mention of install paths.

tests.note: Exit 3, stderr 'no Chrome: CHROME_BIN is unset or empty'. No browser started. Before this fix the same call returned the Program Files chrome.exe.

tests.command: same command with CHROME_BIN='' and with CHROME_BIN=C:\nope\chrome.exe
tests.note: Both exit 3. The messages are 'unset or empty' and 'is not a file'.

tests.command: same command with CHROME_BIN pointing at the Edge msedge.exe path
tests.note: Exit 3, 'refusing CHROME_BIN=...: that is Edge, which is never started on this machine'. Refused by name before any launch. The msedge process count was 5 before and 5 after (the person's own Edge, not started by this run).

tests.command: python -I -X utf8 .taad/slices/SL-008/run_finish_e004_2.py --root <worktree>   (CHROME_BIN = C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe, TAAD3_HOME = scratch folder)
tests.note: Finish line 2: 'Ran 1 test in 8.504s OK', exit 0. msedge count 5 before and 5 after, 0 leftover hband processes.

Signed-in look exit 0: PASS at 360, 400 and 1000 px on the branch page and the report page (scrollWidth 360, 400, 985). The toggle click and re-click restored hidden, aria-expanded and the label. msedge count unchanged, 0 leftover hband processes.

follow_ups: The approved finish body in the ledger (epics id 42, item 2) still lists msedge.exe and ignores CHROME_BIN. It was already reported to the person. The scratch runner patches around it and the body itself is untouched.

The tracked .taad/slices/SL-008/__pycache__/run_finish_e004_2.cpython-314.pyc is stale. It was already modified in the tree before this attempt and I did not regenerate or commit it. It should be removed from version control by a person.
